question: True per-frame cost of the Stage 7c sigma terms
why_first_answer_wrong: The off arm zeroed DISAGREE_K/SUPPORT_FRAC/SPREAD_K, which leaves the reduced-grid fields, both cv2.blur calls, the GPU upsample and the full-frame var add still running. It measured arithmetic values, not arithmetic.
method: Bypass the block entirely vs run it. 40 real logged frames x 3 reps, deployed engines, 1640x1232.
verdict: Cost is 10.6 ms, 13x the originally reported 0.80 ms. Prediction matches the live measurement, closing the loop.
lesson: Zeroing a constant is not the same as skipping the work; an off arm must bypass the branch.
